name: ZenStack
title: zenstack.dev
shortDescription: ZenStack is a TypeScript toolkit that leverages Prisma ORM to enhance full-stack development. It integrates flexible authorization and auto-generates type-safe APIs and hooks, making it ideal for developers seeking to streamline their workflow. By embedding access control policies within the data model, ZenStack simplifies security and reduces the need for complex code. An example use case is a developer quickly setting up secure CRUD APIs for a web application, significantly cutting down development time.
pros: Integrates flexible authorization directly in the data model
cons: May not support all database types
Potentially steep learning curve for new users
